title: Wichita State men's basketball signs Desmeon Jones to complete 2026-27 roster - Sunflower State News
text:
Wichita State men’s basketball finalized its 2026-27 roster with the signing of Desmeon “NuNu” Jones to a financial aid agreement, the university announced on May 27.
Jones joins Wichita State after playing his freshman year at Blinn College in the junior college ranks. Head coach Paul Mills said, “We are excited to add a player of Desmeon’s caliber to our roster. He has proven himself to be one of the best point guards in the junior college ranks during the 2026 season. He led his team in assists, steals, free throws made and free throws attempted while also finishing second on his team in scoring. His ability to attack the rim while also creating opportunities for his teammates really jumped out to our staff as we watched him play. He makes an immediate impact on both ends of the court due to his quickness. Desmeon is a winner.”
During his first collegiate season, Jones started all 31 games for Blinn College and averaged 12.4 points, 4.8 assists, 2.9 rebounds and 2.1 steals per game. He scored at least ten points in 26 games and recorded multiple assists in every game he played that season.
Jones led Region 14 in assists and was second in steals during his time at Blinn College. Notable performances included a season-high 22 points against Lamar State College on December 10, eight assists against Bossier Parish Community College on February 28, and six steals at Lee College on January 21.
A native of Dallas, Texas, Jones attended Lancaster High School—the same school as current Shocker Dillon Battie—where they helped secure a Class 5A state title.
